<STRUCT_0001>
In this chapter we verify basic properties of moduli spaces
and moduli stacks such as
<MATH_0001>, <MATH_0002>, <MATH_0003>,
<MATH_0004>, <MATH_0005>,
<MATH_0006>, <MATH_0007>, <MATH_0008>,
<MATH_0009>, <MATH_0010>, and
<MATH_0011>.
We have already shown these algebraic spaces or algebraic stacks
under suitable hypotheses, see Quot, Sections
<REF_0001>,
<REF_0002>,
<REF_0003>,
<REF_0004>,
<REF_0005>,
<REF_0006>,
<REF_0007>,
<REF_0008>,
<REF_0009>,
<REF_0010>,
<REF_0011>, and
<REF_0012>.
The stack of curves, denoted <MATH_0012> and introduced
in Quot, Section <REF_0013>, is discussed in the
chapter on moduli of curves, see
Moduli of Curves, Section <REF_0014>.
